profile_text.body:
Inceptive is a for-profit startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California. On its own site the company describes itself as building foundation models of life, models that extrapolate from data to design medicines for challenging diseases. It says its team of scientists, AI researchers, and engineers works together where wet and dry lab work meet, and that it is hiring across AI and biology. The company describes partnerships as strategic alliances in which it tunes models, uses data, and transfers knowledge with partners.

The site presents the company's aim as learning the mechanisms of life and designing novel therapies, and it frames its models as tools for optimizing AI investment and pipeline work for partners. No products are tracked for Inceptive in the available record, and no MCP servers are listed.

No lawsuits involving the company appear in the available record.
